Disinvestment of PSUs
*141. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention
has been drawn to the news-item
captioned 'Politics stalled NALCO sale'
which appeared in the 'Hindustan Times',
dated the 2nd November, 2002;
(b) whether disinvestment process of
NALCO, EIL, RCF, Neyveli Lignite
Corporation Limited and BEML are being
delayed, deliberately; and
(c) if not, the reasons for not moving
fast on the disinvestment of the above
PSUs?
Private employment exchanges
†*142. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering grant of permission for
opening of private employment
exchanges;
(b) whether it is a fact that a number
of private employment exchanges are
operating even at present without
Government's permission;
(c) if so, the steps taken by
Government to stop cheating of the
unemployed persons by these private
employment exchanges; and
(d) if no action has been taken, so far,
the reasons therefor?

number of parties including Hurriyat were

Satyagraha by workers
*144. SHRI JIBON ROY:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that on January
8, 2003 a nation-wide Satyagraha was
observed by the workers affiliated to
different Central Trade Unions and
independent employees federations;
(b) if so, what were their demands; and
(c) Government's response thereto?
Accidents on National Highways
*145. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH :
Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHW AYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that lakhs of innocent people are
being killed on the National Highways
every year;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of the accidents and
deaths that have taken place during the
last five years, State-wise; and
(d) the steps being taken to prevent
such accidents?
Packing of drinking water
*146. SHRI SUKHDEV SINGH
LIBRA:
DR. ABRAR AHMED:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRI -
BUTION be pleased to state what steps have
been taken for the implementation of the new
standards for packaged drinking water which
does not conform to European Standards?
Crisis in sugar industry
*147. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
DR. AKHILESH DAS :
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DIS-
TRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether a high level inter-
ministerial meeting was held by the Prime
Minister to find a solution to the current
crisis in sugar industry; and
(b) if so, the details of the discussion
which took place and the steps being taken
to end the crisis?
Cheap Nepalese vanaspati
*148. SHRI RUMANDLA
RAAMACHANDRAYYA:
DR.   T.   SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DIS-
TRIBUTION be pleased to state:

(a) whether he has convened an
emergency meeting alongwith the
Ministries  of Finance, Commerce and
Health to look into the onslaught of cheap
Nepalese vanaspati putting survival of the
Rs. 5,000 crore domestic industry into
question;
(b) if so, what was the main agenda of
meeting;
(c) whether all the vanaspati units in
eastern India have been closed down
following Nepalese dumping triggered by
Government's policy;
(d) what decision has been taken to
meet the situation; and
(e) to what extent this decision has
helped in improving the vanaspati units
in the country?

Industrial development in Assam
922. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the rural industries
development schemes under
implementation in Assam;
(b) the increase in production and
employment registered in these industries;
and
(c) the details of the funds allotted/
sanctioned, released, and utilised for this
purpose during the last three years?
Khadi and Gramodyog Commission
†923. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
plan to expand branches of the Khadi
Gramodyog throughout the country
through the Khadi and Gramodyog
Commission;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) what effective steps have so far been
taken by Government to establish small
industries related to Khadi in the country,
particularly in rural areas of the country?
Rural industries in HP
924. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) what initiative Government have
taken to provide more employment
opportunities in Rural/Snow bound/
Backward areas in Himachal Pradesh to
promote Rural Industries in the State;
(b) the steps taken to improve village
industries in Himachal Pradesh, district-
wise; and
(c) what assistance has been extended
to the State under this scheme?

Cell phone consumers
928. SHRI CHO S. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICA-
TIONS  AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cell phone
consumers under various categories of cell
phone operated by Government;
(b) what is the turn over on account of
this cell phone industry;
(c) what is response of the public
towards various schemes offered by these
operations; and
(d) what steps are being taken to
improve upon the quality of the services
provided to the consumers?
Impact of telecom tariffs increase on
I.S.Ps.
929. SHRI PARMESHWAR KUMAR
AGARWALLA: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS  AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the increase
in telecom tariffs as announced by TRAI,
would affect the Internet Service Providers
(ISPs) as well as the internet users;
(b) the existing average cost per hour
for surfing the net through a dial-up
connection; and
(c) the average cost per hour for surfing
the net through a dial-up connection after
the revised rates as announced by TRAI
come to be effective from April, 2003?
Refund of security money
930. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the norms for refund of security
radiation leakage from 'Rawat Bhata
Atomic Power Plant' in Rajasthan and
'Jaduguda Uranium Mines' have never been
resolved;
(b) whether Government have
conducted a high level and impartial
enquiry regarding the leakages;
(c) if so, the details of the reports; and
(d) whether these reports can be made
available?
Progress in software
926. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has been admitted in the
Science Congress held in Bangalore that
India's progress in software has been
service based but not product-based;
(b) whether it has also been admitted
in the Congress that the World is moving
towards China beacause of China's stride
in I.T. sector; and
(c) if so, what steps are being taken to
ensure that the country does not lag behind
China in this vital sector?
 ATM's in post offices in Karnataka

Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
install ATMs in post offices of Karnataka;
(b) if so, how many post offices have
been identified for this purpose in the State;
(c) whether some banks have
approached the Department of Posts in
Karnataka for this purpose; and
(d) if so, the decision if any taken in
this regard?
